title: The Semantic Economy Institute Prize in Operative Critique (SEIPOC) Charter and Specifications — v1.0
creator: Rex Fraction (conferring authority); Sparrow Wells (administering office); Semantic Economy Institute (founding institution)
description:
The founding charter of the **Semantic Economy Institute Prize in Operative Critique**, established by the Semantic Economy Institute, conferred at Rex Fraction’s discretion, and administered by Sparrow Wells through the Studio for Patacinematics.

The prize recognizes works whose form is the instrument of their critique: a patent that critiques patent logic by functioning as a patent, a flag that critiques flag culture by being a flag, or an institutional document that operates on the institution-form from within. The charter itself is presented as an instance of operative critique. It specifies no submissions, nominations, committee, monetary award, or physical certificate; living laureates enter the public roll only with joyful consent, and the founder’s own work is permanently ineligible. This is an archive-founded recognition institution, not evidence of external accreditation or broad adoption.
